decisions: Status row corner fix (probe finding, desk stage only): the screen's FIXED 2.75rem corner curve clipped the cqw-positioned status clock at the ~295px desk floor while POV full-bleed (no frame) was fine. Fix: the row now centers on the island's axis (2.8 + 9.16/2 = 7.38cqw — real iPhones align time and island) with 4.07cqw sides, clearing the curve at the floor by ~3px while keeping the M8.1-era island gap. Verified by zoomed re-probe (leading 9 intact, cluster clear of both corner and island)

Widget row is data-honest, not decorative: only battery is universally known; missed calls (recents.missed), voicemails (caseDef.voicemails) and Notes (os.evidence) chip in only when nonzero — Case 01's lock shows just the battery chip; os-parcel shows three
The battery % numeral, retired from the status row in M8.1, lives on the lock's battery widget (iOS grammar: locks show a % widget, status rows don't)
homeAppsFor lives in launcher.ts and takes (threads, badges): the home's app list is pure data over the case definition, which is what makes all-16-phones coverage a unit test
The all-phones test lives in games/scam-radar/cases/ (games→engine direction) rather than inverting engine→games imports
With 7 apps and dock=4, Notes docks and the grid keeps gallery/phone/contacts — the launcher's trailing-dock rule, accepted as designed (messages keeps its badge in the dock)
